BETA Close X Drax Group PLC has announced the purchase of 71,261 ordinary shares on April 7, 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The volume-weighted average price paid per share was 883.3901 pence, with the lowest price at 878.6000 pence and the highest at 894.6000 pence. Following this transaction, Drax Group's total issued ordinary shares, including treasury shares, stand at 432,461,089, with 96,197,759 held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is 336,263,330. Since the program's inception on July 31, 2025, Drax Group has repurchased a total of 9,149,163 ordinary shares. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 08 April 2026 8 April 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 7 April 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 71,261 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 878.6000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 894.6000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 883.3901 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 96,197,759. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 7 April 2026 is 336,263,330. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 9,149,163 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
